exposure: Modified Bishop's score (MBS) at the start of induction of labour (VE-1)
Components of MBS (dilatation, length, consistency, station, position of the cervix)
cohort: The study participants were nulliparous women undergoing induction of labour.
finding: Measures of cervical favourability taken after pharmacological/mechanical ripening (VE-2), particularly a simplified modified Bishop's score (sMBS) omitting cervical position, were better predictors of induced labour duration than initial measures (VE-1).
cross-section timing: Measurements were taken at the start of induction of labour (VE-1) and after pharmacological/mechanical ripening (VE-2), approximately 12 hours later.
